_comment: Deterministic sentence assembly. Each fragment turns one answer into one sentence. {answer} is the user text or the option outputText; {role} is the occupation from stage 0. 'case' controls the first letter of {answer}. Nothing here generates text - it only frames what the user chose or wrote.
_comment_budget: The original brief proposed a 400-1200 target warning above 2000. Measured output now runs shorter than the first version because most answers are picked rather than typed, but a complete description still exceeds 1200. Confirm the real field limit with the form owner and set hardLimit; null means unconfirmed.
